Requirements You are undetected by a creature.

You appear from seemingly nowhere to grab an unsuspecting victim. Stride up to 10 feet and attempt to [[/act grapple]] a creature you are undetected by. If you succeed, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier (@Damage[(@actor.system.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]) to the target (double damage if you critically succeed).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
